description: A member's attestation accepting the Covenant Transparency Doctrine terms per ADR-2605310100 §1/§2. R0 skeleton. The doctrine rests on the VOLUNTARY-COVENANT model: a member opts in to (a) anonymity abolished — every act bound to an accountable DID+SBT; (b) full member-to-member visibility — every believer can see every member action; (c) no member-to-member secrecy. Those who require individuated protection are, per founder direction, free to not accept and to seek another community; this record is the on-chain expression of acceptance. CONSTITUTIONAL: acceptance does NOT waive the §4 floor (secrets/keys), and the doctrine itself is `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) — `ratificationStatus` reflects this. Intersection with §1.13 Eros / pastoral content visibility is an OPEN QUESTION reserved to Council (§5); this attestation does NOT pre-decide it.

memberDid.description: DID of the member accepting the covenant transparency terms.

acceptsAnonymityAbolished.description: MUST be true. Accepts that every action is bound to an accountable DID+SBT (§1).

acceptsFullMemberVisibility.description: MUST be true. Accepts that every believer can see every member action (§2).

acknowledgesNoMemberSecrecy.description: MUST be true. Acknowledges there is no member-to-member secrecy tier (§1).

doctrineAdrCid.description: CID of ADR-2605310100 (the Covenant Transparency Doctrine) the member is attesting to.

charterRiderVersion.description: Charter Compliance Rider version in force at attestation (e.g. v2.0).

floorAcknowledgementCid.description: Optional reference to the §4 floor statement the member acknowledges is NOT waived (secrets/keys never published).

ratificationStatus.description: MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity ratifies the doctrine (ADR-2605310100 §5).

councilRatificationCid.description: Set only after Council Lv7+ unanimity is recorded on-chain; absent at R0.
